name: ELSTER / German Tax
description: Generate ELSTER USt-Voranmeldung (XML) and EUER (Excel) files, and file USt-VA directly to the Finanzamt via ERiC using your own ELSTER certificate.

apiKey.instructions: Provide your ELSTER signing certificate (.pfx/.p12) and its PIN. Stored encrypted and used only host-side to sign your USt-VA submission — the certificate and PIN never enter the integration sandbox.

fields.label: Certificate (.pfx, base64)
fields.description: Base64-encoded contents of your ELSTER .pfx/.p12 certificate file.

steuernummer.title: Steuernummer (13-digit)
steuernummer.description: Your 13-digit bundeseinheitliche (federal) Steuernummer for ELSTER. Convert your regional Steuernummer with the official ELSTER converter if needed.

finanzamt.title: Finanzamt
finanzamt.description: Identifier of the responsible Finanzamt (Bundesfinanzamtsnummer / BUFA-Nr).

companyName.title: Company / Business Name
companyName.description: Business name written into the generated ELSTER file (DatenLieferant / Unternehmer).

exports.name: USt-Voranmeldung (ELSTER)
exports.description: Build an ELSTER-ready USt-VA XML for a single reporting period, ready to upload yourself in Mein ELSTER.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

exports.name: EUER (Excel)
exports.description: Aggregate a full tax year into the Anlage EUER line set and produce an Excel workbook with summary lines and traceable transaction detail.

actions.name: Preview USt-VA figures
actions.description: Compute the USt-VA Kennzahlen for a period and return them as JSON for review. Read-only; AI-callable.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

actions.name: Validate USt-VA
actions.description: Validate a USt-VA filing for a period against ELSTER/ERiC without submitting it. Read-only; AI-callable.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

actions.name: Submit USt-VA
actions.description: Sign and submit a USt-VA filing to the Finanzamt via ELSTER/ERiC. Irreversible in production mode. Internal: NOT AI-callable, reached only from the confirmation UI.

period.title: Period
period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

production.title: Production send
production.description: When true, perform a REAL, irreversible submission to the Finanzamt. Defaults to a non-binding test transmission.

actions.name: Filing status
actions.description: List the USt-VA filings produced by this installation and their state. Read-only; AI-callable.
